about_the_game:
Listen up as Ozzy Man, the hilarious YouTuber, lends you his voice for Multiplayer combat! The Aussie comic, commentator, and critic brings his signature style to Call of Duty, keeping it real on killstreaks and enemy activity, adding an extra bit of humor to every MP firefight.

This content is only available in English.
